title: 第五章变废为宝第六章敛气诀
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: 一晃，便是过去了半个月。
这半个月里，江离把所有空闲时间都用在了修炼上。
说是勤能补拙，奈何江离五灵根的天资实在过于差劲。
到现在为止，依旧无法运行满一个周天。
修行速度堪称龟速。
哗啦！
江离有些心不在焉的想着修炼的事，将一筐炼丹失败产生的炉灰倒下山崖。
“这是？”
飘洒下的炉灰中，几粒炼制失败，灰不溜秋的废丹冒了出来，随着炉灰一同被丢下了山崖。
江离心中灵光一闪，冒起了一个念头。
残缺功法放进木盒之中能变成一篇完整功法，那这废丹放入木盒之中，是不是也可以？
炼废的丹药本是无用之物，只有被当垃圾丢弃的份儿。
若是黑色木盒能将废丹变废为宝的话，从今往后，还何愁没有丹药？
修行之路并非没有捷径，服丹便是捷径之一。
听宋展说，这炉炼制失败的丹药，就是用来帮助修仙者提升修炼速度的纳气丹。
不行！
必须要试试！
江离立刻翻找其另一框炉灰。
经过不懈努力，他终于在黑漆漆的炉灰中找到了九枚废丹。
揣进怀中，确定炉灰中不再有遗漏，这才将炉灰一股脑的倒了下去。
日落月升。
江离拖着疲惫的身子终于回到了自己的房间。
关好门窗，插好门闩，拿出黑色木盒。
“希望管用，希望管用。”
嘴中念叨着，九枚黑乎乎的废丹被他丢进木盒之中。
剩下的便是等待了。
江离倒也没有干等，在床上盘膝而坐，再次修炼起来。
不知过了多久，江离突然睁开双眼。
淡淡药香，已经进入他的鼻孔。
江离心中一喜。
成了！
打开木盒一看，里面果然安静躺着九枚完好的纳气丹。
此时木盒中的丹药已经不是焦黑的颜色，每一粒都洁白如玉，如同糖豆一般。
江离急忙从怀中拿出一个玉瓶，将纳气丹全部装了进去。
content_en:
In a blink of an eye, half a month has passed.
In the past half month, Jiang Li spent all his free time on training.
It is said that hard work can make up for weakness, but Jiang Li's talent for Wulinggen is really too poor.
So far, it still cannot run for a full week.
The speed of practice can be called a turtle speed.
Wow!
Jiang Li was absent-mindedly thinking about his cultivation, and poured a basket of ashes from the failed alchemy down the cliff.
"This is it?"
Among the falling ashes, a few grains failed to be refined, and gray waste elixirs emerged, and were thrown off the cliff along with the ashes.
An idea flashed in Jiang Li's mind.
If the incomplete exercise can be turned into a complete exercise by putting it in a wooden box, can it also be done by putting this useless elixir in a wooden box?
The spent elixirs are useless and can only be discarded as garbage.
If the black wooden box can turn waste elixirs into treasures, why worry about not having elixirs from now on?
The road to spiritual practice is not without shortcuts, and taking elixirs is one of them.
I heard from Song Zhan that the elixir that failed to be refined was the Qi-receiving elixir used to help immortal cultivators increase their cultivation speed.
no!
Must try!
Jiang Li immediately rummaged through another frame of ashes.
After unremitting efforts, he finally found nine waste pills in the dark ashes.
He put it into his arms and made sure that there were no more omissions in the ashes, then he poured the ashes down.
Sunset and moonrise.
Jiang Li finally returned to his room dragging his exhausted body.
Close the doors and windows, insert the latch, and take out the black wooden box.
"Hope it works, hope it works."
While muttering in his mouth, he threw nine black waste pills into the wooden box.
All that's left is to wait.
Jiang Li didn't wait any longer. He sat cross-legged on the bed and started practicing again.
After an unknown amount of time, Jiang Li suddenly opened his eyes.
The faint medicinal fragrance has entered his nostrils.
Jiang Li felt happy.
Done!
When he opened the wooden box and took a look, he found nine intact Qi-Naking Pills lying quietly inside.
At this time, the pills in the wooden box were no longer burnt black, each pill was as white as jade, like jelly beans.
Jiang Li hurriedly took out a jade bottle from his arms and put all the Naqi Pills in it.
